image.name: mullvad-browser
image.description: The [Mullvad Browser](https://mullvad.net/en/browser) is a privacy-focused web browser developed in a collaboration between Mullvad VPN and the Tor Project. It’s designed to minimize tracking and fingerprinting. You could say it’s a Tor Browser to use without the Tor Network. Instead, you can use it with a trustworthy VPN.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Suppress sandbox security warning as it's misleading inside a container.
Rebase to Selkies, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED.
Update Readme with new env vars and ingest proper PWA icon.

env_vars.name: LOCAL_NET
env_vars.desc: If using a VPN, set this to your local LAN IP range using CIDR notation. Without it you will be unable to access the web interface. If you have multiple ranges or a complex LAN setup you will need to manage this yourself in the wg0.conf, see the App Setup section for details.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This is needed for any modern website to function like youtube.

caps.desc: Neccessary for Wireguard to create its VPN interface.

image.title: Mullvad-browser
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  mullvad-browser:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mullvad-browser:latest
    container_name: mullvad-browser
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - LOCAL_NET=192.168.0.0/16 #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/mullvad-browser/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=mullvad-browser \
  --cap-add=NET_ADMIN \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e LOCAL_NET=192.168.0.0/16 `#optional` \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/mullvad-browser/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mullvad-browser:latest
